name: SITA Aero Flight Schedule API
description: Provides flight schedule data including routes between airports, airline schedules, and airport-specific departure/arrival information. Supports filtering by airline, flight number, and date range with detailed schedule attributes including aircraft type, terminal assignments, meal service, and on-time performance.
